name: Electron-beam evaporation
purpose: Deposit research metal films on patterned substrates.
geometryBrief: Chamber door, hearth, source, wafer carousel, thickness monitor and vacuum controls.
behaviorBrief: Directional film growth, shadowing, thickness and lift-off compatibility.
inputs: Patterned substrate and mask height, source direction, material and calibrated deposited thickness
outputs: Directional metal-layer map and shadow boundaries on the sample
acceptance: Project a parallel oblique flux past a vertical mask edge of known height. The shadow length must match the geometric projection to one lateral grid cell.

name: Thermal evaporation
geometryBrief: Bell jar or chamber configuration, source boat, substrate mount, valves and gauges.
behaviorBrief: Simplified evaporation flux, thickness and uniformity; exact configuration needs photos.
inputs: Sample mount pose, source geometry, calibrated flux map and exposure interval
outputs: Thickness map linked to evaporant and chamber configuration
acceptance: Place mirror-image coupons about the axis of a symmetric source fixture. Their thickness profiles must mirror each other; zero exposure adds zero film.

name: Magnetron sputtering
purpose: Deposit conductive or insulating films using target-specific processes.
geometryBrief: Vacuum chamber, target mounts, power rack, pressure readout and sample stage.
behaviorBrief: Material-dependent thickness, coverage and stress proxies; no unsupported rate constants.
inputs: Material target ID, calibrated deposition-rate map, sample orientation and run duration
outputs: Sputtered layer revision with thickness field and calibration provenance
acceptance: Use a fixed-rate witness-coupon profile twice with durations in a 1:2 ratio. Central thicknesses must follow 1:2 in the linear regime; a missing rate must be flagged.
simulationStatus: Numerical witness map · verified synthetic cases

name: Sputter system
geometryBrief: Cabinet, chamber, sample handling and controller; verify target count/configuration.
behaviorBrief: Same deposition interface with machine-specific limits.
inputs: Installed target list, layer sequence, substrate revision and target-specific rate profiles
outputs: Ordered multilayer stack with target IDs and spatial thickness for each layer
acceptance: Deposit simulated materials A then B with distinct profile maps. Cross-section inspection must find B above A and recover both original thickness maps.

name: Atomic layer deposition
geometryBrief: Reactor, precursor cabinet, tubing, valves and operator interface.
behaviorBrief: Cycle-based thickness using measured growth-per-cycle; distinguish assumed conformality.
inputs: Substrate surface, material ID, cycle count and fitted growth-per-cycle data
outputs: Barrier-layer thickness and cycle history with stated coverage assumptions
acceptance: Use an ideal saturated constant-growth fixture with no incubation. Doubling the cycle count must double thickness; zero cycles leave the initial surface unchanged.

name: Plasma-enhanced ALD
purpose: Deposit films with plasma-assisted surface reactions.
geometryBrief: Chamber, plasma source, load lock where fitted and cabinet.
behaviorBrief: Layer growth, temperature and process-history metadata; use calibrated material models.
inputs: Surface revision, cycle sequence, plasma-step flags and material calibration domain
outputs: Layer revision with cycle and temperature history, thickness and coverage confidence
acceptance: Replay a complete cycle train against a held-out witness-film measurement. An interrupted final cycle must remain incomplete and must not silently earn a full cycle increment.

name: PECVD
geometryBrief: Vacuum reactor, electrode assembly, gas rack and display.
behaviorBrief: Thickness, dielectric property, stress and conformality approximation.
inputs: Substrate geometry, calibrated deposition map, dielectric model and virtual deposition interval
outputs: Dielectric layer with thickness map and property provenance for electrical analysis
acceptance: Build two equal-area parallel-plate fixtures with dielectric thicknesses in a 1:2 ratio. With fixed permittivity and fringing disabled, predicted capacitances must have a 2:1 ratio.

name: Parylene coating
purpose: Coat flexible or three-dimensional implant structures with parylene.
geometryBrief: Cylindrical chamber, lid, front control panel, vaporizer/pyrolysis modules and cold trap as documented.
behaviorBrief: Track conformal polymer layer and masked regions; closed chamber during processing.
inputs: Exposed surface mesh, masking geometry and calibrated nominal coating thickness
outputs: Conformal polymer surface revision and masked contact map
acceptance: Coat an ideal coupon with an exposed top and sidewall plus a masked contact. Both exposed faces acquire the specified normal offset while the contact remains open.
geometryStatus: First-pass metric Labcoter 2 exterior and illustrated dry holder
simulationStatus: Verified read-only normal offsets and contact-mask geometry; no deposition
integrationStatus: Inspect reference geometry, export mask report and reuse metric VR targets

name: Polymer cure / anneal furnace
purpose: Cure polyimide or thermally process substrates.
geometryBrief: Tube, end flanges, temperature controller, sample boat and stand.
behaviorBrief: Thermal history, shrinkage/stress proxy, material-dependent cure state.
inputs: Polymer film revision, temperature history, timebase and fitted cure/shrinkage model
outputs: Cure-state field, thickness change and thermal provenance
acceptance: Replay a calibration coupon's thermal trace and compare predicted shrinkage with an independent thickness measurement. A zero-duration replay must preserve its initial state.

name: High-temperature box furnace
purpose: Heat or anneal compatible coupons and fixtures.
geometryBrief: Hinged chamber door, insulated interior, display and shelf.
behaviorBrief: Temperature-time history; material changes only if supported by model.
inputs: Compatible coupon ID, programmed chamber trace and material-response model if available
outputs: Thermal history and any explicitly modeled change to the specimen
acceptance: Replay a ramp–hold–cool fixture for an inert coupon. Match the supplied peak and hold duration within the sampling interval and leave material properties intact.

name: Rapid thermal processing
model: Modular Process Technology RTP system (model pending)
purpose: Short thermal cycles on semiconductor substrates.
geometryBrief: Lamp chamber and tray, controller, safety envelope.
behaviorBrief: Thermal ramp, dwell and cooldown; specific equipment model to be pinned.
inputs: Wafer revision, lamp-cycle command, sampled temperature trace and clock basis
outputs: Short-cycle history with measured ramp, peak and dwell linked to the wafer
acceptance: Feed a synthetic triangular temperature trace of known slope. Recover both ramp rates and peak from the samples; do not insert a dwell in a waveform with none.

name: Plasma surface treatment
purpose: Activate surfaces for bonding or microfluidic assembly.
geometryBrief: Small vacuum chamber, viewing port, controls and pump.
behaviorBrief: Surface activation and time-dependent bonding eligibility; not a full surface chemistry solver.
inputs: Two surface IDs, activation calibration, treatment timestamps and bonding eligibility rule
outputs: Time-stamped surface activation and eligibility metadata for the bonding station
acceptance: Give two identical surfaces the same virtual activation and evaluate them on opposite sides of a fixture expiry time. Only the earlier pair qualifies under that fixture rule.
